comment: Weather as presentation (Phase B, B5): what each state does to Sky3D (its node: 'sky3d'; its dome: 'dome' - property names as Sky3D
2.1 declares them), to the environment's fog (fog_scale multiplies the depth and volumetric fog densities) and to the world wind
(wind: [strength, gust], 0-1); 'environment' sets the world environment's own properties. 'all' applies under every state: the
sunset's horizon light less orange (Sky3D's defaults read as over-saturated), and a night you can see by - a brighter moon, and
over half the night's ambient from a cool moonlit colour rather than the black sky (Sky3D's night_sky_contribution). There is no weather in the simulation yet: a run picks a state with
--visual weather=<state> (fair by default); a domain weather is a coordination item.
